data.rationale: Commit 6b3f8857aa moved the invocation of qp_callback in query_planner() from inside the join-removal loop to after it. Previously, when self-join elimination (SJE) or outer-join removal restarted query_planner, qp_callback had already run and adjust_group_pathkeys_for_groupagg had set Aggref.aggpresorted flags that were not reset on restart. This fix is reached by queries combining self-joins or removable joins on unique/primary keys (such as t1.c0) with multiple DISTINCT aggregates and GROUP BY clauses that engage presorted aggregate pathkey optimizations.
seeds: SELECT count(DISTINCT a1.c1) AS c1_cnt, count(DISTINCT a1.c0) AS c0_cnt, sum(DISTINCT a2.c1) AS c1_sum FROM t1 a1 JOIN t1 a2 ON a1.c0 = a2.c0;
SELECT a1.c1, count(DISTINCT a1.c0), sum(DISTINCT a2.c1) FROM t1 a1 JOIN t1 a2 USING (c0) GROUP BY a1.c1 ORDER BY a1.c1;
SET LOCAL enable_self_join_elimination = ON; EXPLAIN (COSTS OFF) SELECT count(DISTINCT a1.c1), sum(DISTINCT a2.c1) FROM t1 a1 JOIN t1 a2 ON a1.c0 = a2.c0;
SELECT count(DISTINCT a1.c1), count(DISTINCT a2.c1), sum(DISTINCT a3.c1) FROM t1 a1 JOIN t1 a2 ON a1.c0 = a2.c0 JOIN t1 a3 ON a1.c0 = a3.c0;
